summary: Build discovery, prioritisation, OKR, and roadmap skills for digital products. Explore the five-day course and practical curriculum.
lede: Digital product management connects customer discovery with delivery decisions and measurable product outcomes. For product managers, product owners, and transformation leads already involved in product decisions, the training covers mapping opportunities, synthesizing research, and defining outcome-led roadmaps and OKRs. You’ll also practise prioritizing options with RICE and WSJF, framing testable experiments, and communicating evidence-based product decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate digital product management course is designed for professionals who already contribute to digital product decisions and need to strengthen discovery, prioritisation, and outcome-led delivery. This course is designed for: Digital Product Managers who connect customer problems to product outcomes. Senior Product Owners who prioritize digital backlogs against measurable value. Heads of Product who align product strategy with organizational objectives. Digital Transformation Leads who shape product operating models and investment priorities. Product Discovery Leads who plan user research and opportunity mapping. Product Analysts who translate usage data into prioritisation evidence. UX Researchers who connect Jobs-to-be-Done findings to product decisions. Product Operations Managers who maintain roadmap and outcome reporting practices. Digital Banking Product Managers who coordinate discovery across regulated service journeys. Government Digital Service Leads who align public-facing products with user needs.
prerequisites: Prior experience contributing to digital product management, product ownership, user research, or digital transformation work is recommended. Coding or programming is not required. Bring a digital product example from your work if available; sensitive customer or organizational data is not needed.
